doc.brief: Possible transitions between pages in a `GtkStack` widget.
doc.md:
Possible transitions between pages in a `GtkStack` widget.

New values may be added to this enumeration over time.

over_down.brief: Cover the old page by sliding down
over_down.md: Cover the old page by sliding down

over_down_up.brief: Cover the old page sliding down or uncover the new page sliding up, according to order
over_down_up.md: Cover the old page sliding down or uncover the new page sliding up, according to order

over_left.brief: Cover the old page by sliding to the left
over_left.md: Cover the old page by sliding to the left

over_left_right.brief: Cover the old page sliding left or uncover the new page sliding right, according to order
over_left_right.md: Cover the old page sliding left or uncover the new page sliding right, according to order

over_right.brief: Cover the old page by sliding to the right
over_right.md: Cover the old page by sliding to the right

over_right_left.brief: Cover the old page sliding right or uncover the new page sliding left, according to order
over_right_left.md: Cover the old page sliding right or uncover the new page sliding left, according to order

over_up.brief: Cover the old page by sliding up
over_up.md: Cover the old page by sliding up

over_up_down.brief: Cover the old page sliding up or uncover the new page sliding down, according to order
over_up_down.md: Cover the old page sliding up or uncover the new page sliding down, according to order

rotate_left.brief: Pretend the pages are sides of a cube and rotate that cube to the left
rotate_left.md: Pretend the pages are sides of a cube and rotate that cube to the left

rotate_left_right.brief: Pretend the pages are sides of a cube and rotate that cube to the left or right according to the children order
rotate_left_right.md: Pretend the pages are sides of a cube and rotate that cube to the left or right according to the children order

rotate_right.brief: Pretend the pages are sides of a cube and rotate that cube to the right
rotate_right.md: Pretend the pages are sides of a cube and rotate that cube to the right

slide_left_right.brief: Slide from left or right according to the children order
slide_left_right.md: Slide from left or right according to the children order

slide_up_down.brief: Slide from top down or bottom up according to the order
slide_up_down.md: Slide from top down or bottom up according to the order

under_down.brief: Uncover the new page by sliding down
under_down.md: Uncover the new page by sliding down

under_left.brief: Uncover the new page by sliding to the left
under_left.md: Uncover the new page by sliding to the left

under_right.brief: Uncover the new page by sliding to the right
under_right.md: Uncover the new page by sliding to the right

under_up.brief: Uncover the new page by sliding up
under_up.md: Uncover the new page by sliding up
